core_conclusion: Topological quantum computing is theoretically realizable. The research question for current candidate platforms is whether they can pass a falsifiable chain from phase to nonlocal operation and protected logical utility. BREL makes that chain testable and classifies a platform without conflating suggestive local signatures with full realization.
